summary: OTHMODE Skill Trust Gate (SKILL-TRUST-0) code and attestations are verified to be merged to main (commit 5b995e9) and properly configured. The security gate is implemented at lib/skills.js line 292 with fail-closed enforcement: a skill must have a content-bound ACCEPT attestation in skill-trust.json to be selectable. All 31 skills (26 claude + 5 executor) have been scanned by NVIDIA SkillSpector 2.11.0, Gitleaks 8.30.1, and SkillEvaluator 0.2.1 with policy 1.0.0, resulting in 31/31 ACCEPT attestations (verified by skill-trust-cli.js verify → VERIFY OK per AI_HANDOVER). Test suite (skill-trust-test.js 130/0) and all regression suites (othmode-2 147/0, othmode-3 94/0, mcp-ecosystem 168/0, mythos-ai-executor 390/0) pass. The trust gate enforces by refusing to select/render untrusted skills; MYTHOS_SKILL_TRUST bypass is test-only and logged. PRODUCTION ACTIVATION REQUIRED: services must be restarted (mythos-ai-executor, mythos-command-center.service) to load the merged code and activate the live trust gate and read model API. Until then, production runs pre-gate code.
